description: The 964 is the point at which the 911 stopped being a car Porsche kept patching and became a car Porsche actually re-engineered. Announced for 1989, it was roughly 85 percent new against the 3.2 Carrera it replaced. Featuring coil springs in place of the torsion bars, power steering, ABS, a speed-sensitive rear spoiler and the 3.6-litre flat-six making 247 horsepower in US trim, the 964 kept the shape and classic air-cooled DNA but delivered and entirely new 911 experience. [!@@ NL @@!][!@@ NL @@!]The Targa was the smallest part of the 964s production run. And, it was the final air-cooled 911 to feature the true Targa design. The 993 that followed in 1995 abandoned it entirely for a sliding glass roof, so the 964 is where the original Targa idea ends. Far fewer were built than coups or cabriolets in any year of the 964, and 1993 is the thinnest year of all  only 137 cars were built for the US market. [!@@ NL @@!][!@@ NL @@!]Photographed here, our 1993 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 Targa is ultimately, the holy grail. Its a black-black, rear wheel drive air-cooled 911 Targa with only 62k original miles. This particular example has been very well maintained and features unique factory options such as the Porsche branded car-phone as well as the wood trimmed shift knob and e-brake lever. Accompanied by its original books and tools, this car is one of the best representations of an era, model and trim that we will simply never get back.[!@@ NL @@!][!@@ NL @@!]For more information, please contact Walt Grace Vintage at,  or .

description: Hudson Valley drivers searching for a versatile, all-weather crossover will want to take a close look at this 2024 Mazda CX-30 2.5 S Select Sport, now available at Route 9 Mazda in Poughkeepsie. Finished in striking Ceramic Metallic with a Black Artificial Leather interior, this AWD crossover brings Mazda's signature blend of refined style and confident performance to every road in the region  from Route 9 to the Taconic State Parkway corridor and beyond.  Under the hood sits Mazda's SKYACTIV 2.5L 4-Cylinder DOHC 16V engine, paired with a smooth-shifting 6-Speed Automatic transmission and standard all-wheel drive. Inside, the cabin is appointed with leatherette seat trim, heated door mirrors, a leather-wrapped steering wheel with integrated controls, a leather shift knob, and front dual-zone automatic climate control  delivering a premium feel throughout. The 18-inch aluminum alloy wheels with black lug nuts and wheel locks add a sharp, purposeful look to the exterior. Practical touches include a split-folding rear seat, rear center armrest, and ample storage throughout the cabin.  Technology and connectivity are well represented with the MAZDA CONNECT Infotainment System featuring Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, AM/FM audio with six speakers, radio data system, and Mazda Connected Services with a complimentary 3-year trial. Auto high-beam headlights, rain-sensing wipers, a rear parking camera, cruise control, and a low tire pressure warning keep you informed and in control. Telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjustability ensures a personalized driving position for every journey.  Route 9 Mazda is proud to back every new Mazda with the full factory warranty package, giving you confidence behind the wheel from day one and for years to come. The 944 is the car that settled the argument about whether a front-engined Porsche could be a real Porsche. Where the 924 borrowed its four-cylinder from Audi, the 944 carried an engine of its own design effectively, one bank of the 928s V8, cast in aluminum with twin counter-rotating balance shafts. The chassis was widened and flared over the 924s to take the extra width, the gearbox sat at the rear in a transaxle, and the weight landed almost evenly between the axles. The result handled better than anything else Porsche sold at the time, and for most of the decade the 944 outsold the 911.[!@@ NL @@!][!@@ NL @@!]By 1986 the car had received the revision that owners now look for. The mid-1985  replaced the antiquated 924-derived cabin with the oval dashboard, better seats and a new wheel, and brought larger brakes, a bigger fuel tank and central locking. The 2.5-litre M44/07 was rated at 147 horsepower in US form, driving through a five-speed transmission. [!@@ NL @@!][!@@ NL @@!]Photographed here, our 1986 Porsche 944 is an absolute time capsule. Built on the 30th of August 1985 at the Neckarsulm plant, and finished in one of the rarest colors of the era, Sapphire Metallic over a Linen interior with the Porsche fabric seat s, this particular example has gonly only 19k since new. Unlike many ultra low mileage cars, this 944 has been very well servivced and maintained throughout its life and is truly a turn-key trip back to the 80s.
